reports.evidence: Volume conservation gives R = 4r (area ×16) while charge is ×64, so σ ratio = 64/16 = 4:1 (both blind solves, stored solution agrees).
reports.student_reply: The bigger drop does have 16× the area - but it also carries 64× the charge. σ = Q/A gives 64/16 = 4, so 4 : 1 (B) is correct.
